function.name: get_activity_digest
function.description: Get a compact, pre-aggregated summary of active (non-minimized) computer time by category, top applications, top websites, and opened files.

days.description: 0 for today since midnight, 7 for last 7 days, etc. Default 0.

since.description: Optional start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

top_n.description: Maximum items per section (apps, sites, files). Keep small (5-15). Default 10.

function.name: get_focus_blocks
function.description: Get a chronological timeline of merged deep-work/focus blocks (collapses rapid window switches into clean intervals).

days.description: 0 for today, 7 for last 7 days. Default 0.

min_duration_sec.description: Minimum block duration in seconds to include. Default 30.

limit.description: Maximum number of recent blocks to return. Default 25.

function.name: search_activity
function.description: Search active window sessions, opened files, and visited websites by keyword (e.g. project name, filename, domain).

days.description: How many days back to search. Default 7.
